meta.title: Register for the NIS Online Social Security Service

start.title: Register for the NIS Online Social Security Service
intro: Use this form to register for online access to your NIS account. Once registered, you can check your contributions, apply for benefits, and manage your details online — without visiting an NIS office.
You must already have an NIS number to register. If you do not have one, you will need to visit an NIS office first.

eligibility.heading: Who can use this form
items: Barbados residents with a valid NIS number
Overseas applicants with a valid NIS number (your form must be witnessed by a Notary Public)

whatYouNeed.heading: What you will need
items: Your NIS number (6 digits — found on your NIS card or correspondence)
Your Barbados National ID Card or valid passport
Your email address (we will send your login details here)
If you live overseas: details of a Notary Public who will witness your application

fields.label: What type of ID do you have?
NIS number
fields.hint: Your 6-digit National Insurance Number. For example, 123456

validation.patternMessage: NIS number must be exactly 6 digits

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.hint: The Country, State, Province or County the Notary Public works in

fields.label: Date of notarisation
fields._note: Effectively required, but validated in the prototype's validate(). Left non-required here because the schema date-required check reads a single key, not day/month/year, and would always fail.

declaration.title: Declaration
declaration.body: I declare that the information I have given in this form is correct and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that giving false information may result in prosecution.
declaration._note: Checkbox required is enforced in the prototype's validate(); it is left non-required here because the schema treats an untouched checkbox (undefined) as empty and would block submission.

fields.label: I hereby make an application for the National Insurance Online Social Security Service and declare that the information given in this form is true to the best of my knowledge and belief. I also agree to my username and password being sent electronically to my above listed email address.
Notarial certificate (overseas applicants) — confirmed by the Notary Public using the notary details given.

check.title: Check your answers before sending your application

confirmation.heading: Application submitted
nextSteps: We will send your NIS online login details to the email address you gave us.
If you applied from overseas, we will contact you to arrange witnessing by a Notary Public.
If you have any questions, call the NIS on 246-431-7400.

conditionalLogic.description: If the applicant lives overseas, add the Notary Public page after applicant-details
